utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still a little hesitant until we know who’s actually bringing tools, because I don’t want people showing up and finding the setup half-baked. If Rey’s asking, I’d say Saturday’s timing and parking sound workable, but I’m keeping it low-key for now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense. I’m checking quietly today, and so far Gus is still set for 9 with the drill and socket set—I’ll pass along any other tool gaps once I hear back from a couple neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s reassuring, at least—if Gus is solid, this sounds a little less shaky. Let me know what the other tool replies are, and then I can mention it to a couple people without overpromising.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Quinn, the solid confirms I’ve got are Mara with the socket set and Ben with the spare chains and pump, and Faye can help if it’s between 9 and 2:30.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s a great start—thanks, Tess. I’m still spreading the word, so if Mara, Ben, or Faye can nudge anyone else to swing by the community center Saturday from 10 to 2, I’d love a bigger crowd.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll pass that along, and right now Mara and Ben are the firmest yeses, with Faye able to make that 9 to 2:30 window.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: From what I’ve heard, they’re still collecting through Friday, and gloves, extension cords, and hand tools are especially useful.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s good to know — I’ll pass that along and see who can cover those items, and I’m still waiting on the Sunday timing so I can match Faye into the midday window if it fits.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That lines up with what I’d heard too, so hopefully folks still have a little time to gather things. If you hear back on the timing, let me know—I can keep asking around.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ve been telling people Noah’s helping with the repair drive, and I’ll pass along the time again if I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—I’m getting there a little late, so I’ll check the signup table when I arrive and let Cleo know if they’re short on lumber, tarps, or tools.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it—I’ve been telling people Noah’s helping, and if I hear the time again I’ll pass it along so folks stay lined up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I still can’t confirm 9 yet—I’m waiting on Mara to get the organizer’s exact times and volunteer counts for Saturday morning and Sunday after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’ve only got 10 a.m. at the Maple garage on my end, so let’s stick with that till Mara confirms anything else.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That makes sense—let’s use 10 at the Maple garage for now, and I’ll update you as soon as Mara confirms the exact times and how many volunteers they still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, we’re still collecting tools, Kira—drop-offs are open through Friday, and the repair drive itself has moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, but can you confirm whether Mara’s still bringing the socket set and Ben’s still bringing the bike chains and pump now that it’s moved to Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I haven’t gotten any change from Mara or Ben, so as far as I know they’re still bringing them, but I’ll confirm and text you if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Plan stays simple: 10 a.m. at the community garage on Maple, I’ll manage the signup sheet, and you handle tool check-in and patch kits so folks sign up first and we keep it orderly.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it—I’ll be there by 10 to handle tool check-in and the patch kits so your signup line stays moving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that keeps it clear—10 a.m. on Maple, you’ve got tools and patch kits, and I’ll keep the signup sheet moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still good to help with the repair drive between 9 and 2:30, just as long as I can keep clear of school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—can you take cleanup from 9 to 2:30, and do you have any paint supplies or tarps to bring?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Cleanup from 9 to 2:30 works for me, but I’m just helping with time — I don’t have paint supplies or tarps to bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right—Saturday morning, I’ve got tool check-in and the patch kits, and Eli’s keeping the signup sheet so the porch rails and shed roof stay in order.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive logged for Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community garage on Maple, with you on tool check-in and patch kits and Eli on the signup sheet.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds right, thanks, Opal—Saturday at 10 on Maple, and I’ll stick to tool check-in and the patch kits so I don’t muddle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to hear—Leo’s got the porch rails Saturday morning, and Oren’s covering the patch kits, so we should be set to tackle the shed roof right after.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—good, yeah, that sounds right; I’m still in, I just need you to say the time to me again once it’s pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do—I’ll pass along the Saturday morning time as soon as Oren pins it down, and then we can roll straight from the porch rails to the shed roof.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: If you hear who’s still short on lumber, tarps, or hand tools, send them my way and I’ll add it to the repair drive list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m already checking the exact repair times and volunteer needs, and I’ll send over any lumber, tarp, or hand tool shortages as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—that’ll help a lot. If the signup table turns up anything missing too, especially lumber, tarps, or basic tools, let me know and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’m still good for 9 with the drill and socket set, and we can start on those loose fence panels first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good—9 works. Let’s knock out the loose fence panels first, then I’ll stay on the porch rails unless something changes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect—I’ll be there by 9 with the drill and socket set, and we’ll start on the fence panels before you shift to the porch rails.
